title: Tom's Healthy Week
text:
Tom likes to be healthy. Every day, he drinks a glass of water. He eats fruit and vegetables at lunch. He walks to school with his sister.

After school, Tom plays football in the park. He sleeps for nine hours every night. His mother says he is happy and strong.

questions.text: What does Tom drink every day?
What does Tom play after school?
How does Tom probably feel after he sleeps well?

vocabulary.definition: good for your body and in good condition
plants or parts of plants that people eat as food
a clear liquid that people drink
a sport played by two teams kicking a ball

paragraph_translations: Том любить бути здоровим. Щодня він п'є склянку води. На обід він їсть фрукти й овочі. Він ходить до школи разом зі своєю сестрою.
Після школи Том грає у футбол у парку. Він спить дев'ять годин щоночі. Його мама каже, що він щасливий і сильний.
